def get_neighbors(r, c, grid, bg):
    nr, nc = grid.shape

        nr2, nc2 = r+dr, c+dc
        if 0 <= nr2 < nr and 0 <= nc2 < nc and grid[nr2, nc2] == foreground:
            neighs.append((nr2, nc2))
    return neighs

def flood_fill(r, c, grid, bg, fg):
    visited = set()
    stack = [(r, c)]
    while stack:
        curr_r, curr_c = stack.pop()
        if (curr_r, curr_c) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((curr_r, curr_c))
        for neigh in get_neighbors(curr_r, curr_c, grid, bg):

    return visited

for r in range(grid.shape[0]):
    for c in range(grid.shape[1]):

            comp = flood_fill(r, c, grid, background, foreground)
            components.append(comp)
            visited_global.update(comp)

print(f"Number of connected components: {len(components)}")
for i, comp in enumerate(components):

    print(f"Component {i}: size={len(comp)}, rows={min(comp_rows)}-{max(comp_rows)}, cols={min(comp_cols)}-{max(comp_cols)}")
